entries.title: Leviticus 11:1
segments: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying to them,

entries.title: Leviticus 11:2
segments: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the animals which ye shall eat of all the beasts which are on the earth.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:3
segments: Whatever hath cloven hoofs, and feet quite split open, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts--that shall ye eat.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:4
segments: Only these shall ye not eat of those that chew the cud, or of those with cloven hoofs: the camel, for it cheweth the cud, but hath not cloven hoofs--it shall be unclean unto you;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:5
segments: and the rock-badger, for it cheweth the cud, but hath not cloven hoofs--it shall be unclean unto you;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:6
segments: and the hare, for it cheweth the cud, but hath not cloven hoofs--it shall be unclean unto you;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:7
segments: and the swine, for it hath cloven hoofs, and feet quite split open, but it cheweth not the cud--it shall be unclean unto you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:8
segments: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch: they shall be unclean unto you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:9
segments: ¶These shall ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatever hath fins and scales in waters, in seas and in rivers, these shall ye eat;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:10
segments: but all that have not fins and scales in seas and in rivers, of all that swarm in the waters, and of every living soul which is in the waters--they shall be an abomination unto you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:11
segments: They shall be even an abomination unto you: of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase ye shall have in abomination.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:12
segments: Whatever in the waters hath no fins and scales, that shall be an abomination unto you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:13
segments: And these shall ye have in abomination of the fowls; they shall not be eaten; an abomination shall they be: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the sea-eagle,

entries.title: Leviticus 11:14
segments: and the falcon, and the kite, after its kind;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:15
segments: every raven after its kind;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:16
segments: and the female ostrich and the male ostrich, and the sea-gull, and the hawk, after its kind;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:17
segments: and the owl, and the gannet, and the ibis,

entries.title: Leviticus 11:18
segments: and the swan, and the pelican, and the carrion vulture,

entries.title: Leviticus 11:19
segments: and the stork; the heron after its kind, and the hoopoe, and the bat.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:20
segments: ¶Every winged crawling thing that goeth upon all four shall be an abomination unto you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:21
segments: Yet these shall ye eat of every winged crawling thing that goeth upon all four: those which have legs above their feet with which to leap upon the earth.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:22
segments: These shall ye eat of them: the arbeh after its kind, and the solam after its kind, and the hargol after its kind, and the hargab after its kind.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:23
segments: But every winged crawling thing that hath four feet shall be an abomination unto you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:24
segments: And by these ye shall make yourselves unclean; whoever toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:25
segments: And whoever carrieth [ought] of their carcase shall wash his garments, and be unclean until the even.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:26
segments: Every beast that hath cloven hoofs, but not feet quite split open, nor cheweth the cud, shall be unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:27
segments: And whatever goeth on its paws, among all manner of beasts that go upon all four, those are unclean unto you: whoever toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:28
segments: And he that carrieth their carcase shall wash his garments, and be unclean until the even: they shall be unclean unto you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:29
segments: And these shall be unclean unto you among the crawling things which crawl on the earth: the mole, and the field-mouse, and the lizard, after its kind;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:30
segments: and the groaning lizard, and the great red lizard, and the climbing lizard, and the chomet, and the chameleon.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:31
segments: These shall be unclean unto you among all that crawl: whoever toucheth them when they are dead, shall be unclean until the even.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:32
segments: And on whatever any of them when they are dead doth fall, it shall be unclean; all vessels of wood, or garment, or skin, or sack, every vessel wherewith work is done--it shall be put into water, and be unclean until the even; then shall it be clean.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:33
segments: And every earthen vessel into which [any] of them falleth--whatever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:34
segments: All food that is eaten on which [such] water hath come shall be unclean; and all drink that is drunk shall be unclean, in every [such] vessel.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:35
segments: And everything where upon [any part] of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; oven and hearth shall be broken down: they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:36
segments: Nevertheless, a spring or a well, a quantity of water, shall be clean. But he that toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:37
segments: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing-seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:38
segments: but if water have been put on the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:39
segments: And if any beast which is to you for food die, he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:40
segments: And he that eateth of its carcase shall wash his garments, and be unclean until the even: he also that carrieth its carcase shall wash his garments, and be unclean until the even.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:41
segments: And every crawling thing which crawleth on the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:42
segments: Whatever goeth on the belly, and whatever goeth on all four, and all that have a great many feet, of every manner of crawling thing which crawleth on the earth--these ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:43
segments: ¶Ye shall not make yourselves abominable through any crawling thing which crawleth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:44
segments: For I am Jehovah your God; and ye shall hallow yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy; and ye shall not make yourselves unclean through any manner of crawling thing which creepeth on the earth.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:45
segments: For I am Jehovah who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

entries.title: Leviticus 11:46
segments: This is the law of cattle, and of fowl, and of every living soul that moveth in the waters, and of every soul that crawleth on the earth;

entries.title: Leviticus 11:47
segments: to make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that is to be eaten and the beast that is not to be eaten.
